item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Slugterra (2012) Serie 1080p AMZN Web-dl Audio Spanish Latin America + Sub
item.description: Hi everyone. I’d like to make a request for a series: *Slugterra* (known as *Bajoterra* in Latin America) in 1080p. The series is currently available on Amazon Prime Video in the United States. I’m not sure if Amazon included the Latin American Spanish dub—the version that aired on Disney XD in my country (Mexico)—but if it is available on Prime Video, could someone upload the complete series to the site with both that Latin American Spanish dub and the original English audio? It isn't available on any streaming platform in my country, Mexico. Thank you very much.
item.author: Gumball Watterson
